review.verdict: conditionally supported as a bounded research transcription

limitations: Initialization must use a compatible density/void/reference state; independent pressure, rho and void options do not enforce the Table2 reference invariant.
Sustained softening, peak crossings and general cyclic path accuracy are unqualified; softening currently has residual-level evidence.
Finite backward Euler updates exhibit quantified reference-invariant drift.
Source-matched specimen preparation, experimental reproduction and external scientific signature remain open.
No general classical hydro tangent, finite rotation/strain, anisotropy, structure or creep capability.
Browser catalogue and hosted browser-engine qualification remain separate from this bounded Atlas admission.
